description: Self-hosted edge surveillance for NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super (8GB): YOLOv8n+TensorRT detection, ByteTrack, Facenet512 face re-ID, and LFM2-VL 1.6B scene reasoning via llama.cpp — three models coexisting on the shared unified-memory pool. Fully local inference, Flask dashboard, Telegram alerts.
